{{Quote|Takhaff Uul, do you trust in our gods?''"<br />"''I do, Warmaster.''"<br />"''Do they trust ''you''?|Tsavong Lah and Takhaff Uul|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>}}
'''Takhaff Uul''' was a member of the [[priest caste]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. Uul was a [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] of [[Yun-Yuuzhan]], the Creator. After the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]], Uul approached [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]]. He said he had a dream in which Yun-Yuuzhan was angry for not receiving any of the glory from the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]]. Uul said the Creator wanted a whole world to be made into a temple for Yun-Yuuzhan. In truth, Takhaff Uul was conspiring with [[Master Shaper]] [[Ghithra Dal]] to control Lah. On the [[Shaper caste|shaper]] vessel ''[[Fu'ulanh]]'', Lah unleashed a group of [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]], killing Uul, Dal, and their co-conspirators.
